feeds.title: Renegade Writings » Urban Exploration
feeds.description: Renegade Writings talks about the different places that are unexplored like various tunnels, abandoned hotels, temples, and neglected spaces. I am the Renegade Tourist and on this blog, I publish all kinds of content: frozen moments, travel logs, urban exploration, short stories, posts about life in Taiwan, movie and book reviews more!

feeds.title: Urbexiam Blog
feeds.description: Urbexiam Blog explores and covers places that are abandoned and unexplored by people. We try to give important information to the viewers on topics like how many abandoned mines are there in the United States, can Urbex explorers be arrested, how can we explore old abandoned mines, and many more!

feeds.title: Ronny Salerno » Urban Exploration
feeds.description: The page consists of author Ronny Salerno's list of some favorite urban exploration stories from over the years according to both online views and personal preferences. It is a collection of abandoned and rarely seen locales in/around Cincinnati and the United States.

feeds.title: Obsidian Urbex Photography Blog
feeds.description: Catch up with site news, travel diaries, upcoming plans, gear reviews, and other featured items. Stories of my journeys and adventures. Photographs of beautiful abandoned and decaying lost places from around the world. Urban Exploration and Dark Tourism blog, with galleries and portfolio.

feeds.title: Urbex Stalker
feeds.description: Urbex Stalker is a blog about the abandoned world! At Stalker, we document every abandoned place with photos, articles, and research on them, bringing up forgotten pasts and stories.

feeds.title: Abandoned AR
feeds.description: Abandoned Arkansas gives you insight on 300+ abandoned places in Arkansas. Look at our abandoned places in Arkansas from all over the State. Hospitals, Schools, Hotels, and more! All full of history and pictures. We're dedicated to preserving the rich past of AR.

feeds.title: Mechanical Landscapes Blog
feeds.description: Mechanical Landscapes Blog gives a guide to abandoned mechanical places and landscapes that are less known! It aims not just to present a record of the places visited, but to present a creative treatment of actuality.

feeds.title: Freakphotography Blog
feeds.description: The Freaktography Urban Exploring photography blog consists of stories, galleries, and interesting posts for your viewing and reading pleasure. The photographer behind Freaktography is a modern-day explorer choosing to seek out and show the wonders and mysteries of our own backyards through unconventional photography and adventurous Urban Exploration.

feeds.title: Architectural Afterlife
feeds.description: Architectural Afterlife is a blog that was started in 2012 by Cleveland photographer Johnny Joo, sharing the beauty of dusty old Midwest farmhouses and gritty industrial remains of the rust belt. Eventually, the blog content started covering much more than just the Midwest.

feeds.title: Urbexy Blog
feeds.description: We are a small group of urban explorers with an interest in all things related to history. Urban exploration is the discovery and exploration of locations within an urban environment. It could be anything from abandoned houses, factories, or even war-related structures. As we explore these abandoned places, we create videos, take photographs and place them online so we can share them with you.

feeds.title: RiddimRyder Blog
feeds.description: Hi there, My name is Jamie & I am an Ontario-based adventurer. Follow me along on my amazing adventures as I explore abandoned & forgotten places. I am constantly doing research & driving in search of new abandoned locations to explore & document.

feeds.title: Urbex Travel Blog
feeds.description: Check this Urbex Travel Blog site to see amazing pictures from our urban explorations. Here you can learn how to find abandoned places and how to get there. Urban exploration is our passion. We have visited over a hundred abandoned places, and we are still traveling. We have created this blog to share with you our adventures and experience. We would like to show you objects from abandoned houses, mansions, warehouses, factories, and many others.

feeds.title: arcanum.
feeds.description: Pictures, stories and history of abandoned buildings. Exploring the back roads of Germany.

feeds.title: Ripe Arts
feeds.description: The untold stories of Heather Hacker's urbex photography. The stories behind the photographs of urban exploration around the world.

feeds.title: Abandoned Kansai
feeds.description: All abandoned: Chernobyl / Pripyat, Nara Dreamland, Anti-Zombie Fortress, Japanese Sex Museum - and many, many more! Plus: North Korea Special - 2 trips, 16 days / 14 nights! As seen on CNN...

feeds.title: Abandoned Wonders
feeds.description: Here at Abandoned Wonders, we enjoy exploring, researching, and documenting abandoned locations all over New England. May it be railroad stations, homes, cars/trucks, movie theaters, sanatoriums, and more! We love to share our adventures and what we learned along the way about each individual location.

feeds.title: Greg Abandoned » Stories
feeds.description: Greg Abandoned explores stories about various places and writes about them. Our blog is all about facts, figures, and stories about different places like five interesting facts about Chernobyl, Buran story, Bill Finan Quiz, and Urbex stories from Jhon Law.

feeds.title: State of Abandoned Blog
feeds.description: Urban Exploration Blog highlighting various abandoned locations across the world, including historical information, and location photos. This site is dedicated to photographing old, historical, and abandoned buildings, and preserving their history through photographs.

feeds.title: Discover.re
feeds.description: Discover.re explores and documents abandoned, hidden, and unique locations in the UK and Europe. This includes Urban Exploration of derelict buildings and visiting unexplored places that tourists don't often venture to. We never force entry into any location, nothing is ever damaged or taken, and no laws are broken.

feeds.title: Killer Urbex Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Killer Urbex. While getting into the urban exploration scene several years ago, the website owner found the available resources for those looking to get started or hone their craft fell into one of three camps: extremely vague, ridiculously outdated, and unhelpful, and too sales-focused.

feeds.title: Once Occupied
feeds.description: Once occupied believes that andoned places provide a glimpse into the past. As urban explorers, our goal is to tell their story and history. This is what we share not only in our explorations but also in those submitted to us. We never share location information. No need to even ask.

feeds.title: Urbex Underground
feeds.description: Urbex Underground Blog provides a guide on how to find abandoned places, experience the joy of swimming in our infinity-edge pool that gives you a nice picturesque view. The Ultimate Guide To Urban Exploration Set forth on an exquisite wellness journey to refresh, re-energize and rejuvenate at our iconic spa.

feeds.title: Visit Rochester » Urban Exploration
feeds.description: Visit Rochester's Urban Exploration Blog category is all about exploring places in Rochester and tells facts, and gives information about those spots. Always sharing why Rochester, NY is a great place to live, work, learn, play and visit. For all things, Rochester, check out our blog posts and articles! We'll share trip ideas, information on upcoming events, and more

feeds.title: No Tracers Blog
feeds.description: Dive into urban exploration stories, tips, and insights from No Tracers. Explore the world of abandoned places through detailed narratives.

feeds.title: The Pixel Club
feeds.description: The Pixel Club is a Photography Project as we fell in love with photography, it became our greatest hobby, and we are continuously doing interesting experiments. Implementing a photography project is not only a great way to improve our photography skills but it can make your traveling much more interesting.
